title: Reconciliation of Pre-trained Models and Prototypical Neural Networks in Few-shot Named Entity Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the correlation between word frequencies and embedding L2-norms using Principal Component Analysis (PCA), demonstrating that distance metrics in Prototypical Neural Networks (PNNs) disproportionately focus on non-semantic word frequencies rather than entities, and evaluating a prototype normalization remedy across multiple few-shot Named Entity Recognition (NER) benchmark datasets.
